Looking through the cursor skills list, none of them match exactly with ECC or agents skills. Checking cross-references between agents and ECC, I find "code-review" in agents but ECC has "security-review" instead—not an exact duplicate. The only real duplicate I've found so far is "no-mistakes" appearing twice in different nix store paths, which is likely the same skill available through different hashes. Now I'm checking whether "ecc" itself functions as a skill name or if it's just the collection directory.
